emergence.summary: An X-linked single-gene F9 loss-of-function lowers coagulation factor IX, a vitamin-K-dependent serine-protease zymogen that, once activated (FIXa), drives the intrinsic-tenase step of the coagulation cascade (FIXa with cofactor FVIIIa activates factor X). With F9 LOF the procoagulant DRIVE is lost, thrombin/fibrin generation is under-driven, and haemostasis fails -> spontaneous and trauma-related bleeding (haemarthroses, soft-tissue and other bleeds), severity tracking residual factor IX level -> the coagulation-cascade axis is driven DOWN. Read as a lost ACCELERATOR of the coagulation cascade (factor IX drives clot formation; LOF -> under-driven haemostasis), the deficiency-driven DOWN shape -- but on a NEW physiological axis, the coagulation cascade, not previously represented in the kit. Correction RESTORES factor IX. The kit re-derives the gene-restore lead: etranacogene dezaparvovec, a liver-directed AAV5 F9-Padua gene-transfer therapy (the first approved haemophilia B gene therapy), restoring endogenous factor IX -- gene-restore-as-lead on haemostasis, extending the clean gene-restore reads (RPE65/LCA2, DDC/AADC) onto the clotting axis. The long-standing established replace arm is factor IX protein replacement (recombinant / plasma-derived factor IX, including extended-half-life fusions), also direction-consistent (replace the missing factor). The gamma read is of the F9 locus switch STRUCTURE (an AT-rich promoter, among the lowest gamma in the kit, consistent with its X-linked locus); the disease lesion is coding/regulatory (missense/nonsense; the distinct F9-promoter 'haemophilia B Leyden' androgen-responsive regulatory variants that remit at puberty are a SEPARATE class, noted not modelled), outside the structural promoter-window read. X-linked, so penetrance/severity are zygosity-dependent (males hemizygous; carrier females variable by X-inactivation) and held [O]. Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: coagulation-cascade output (factor-IX-driven intrinsic-tenase / thrombin-fibrin generation) -- a new haemostasis axis, the kit's first coagulation read

per_gene.note: F9 encodes coagulation factor IX, a vitamin-K-dependent serine-protease zymogen; activated FIXa is a positive DRIVER of the coagulation cascade (with FVIIIa it activates factor X). As an ACCELERATOR of clot formation, its LOF LOSES the drive -> thrombin/fibrin generation under-driven -> bleeding. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; it does NOT encode the coding lesion (firewall). The pathological axis is the COAGULATION OUTPUT (it goes DOWN), so the corrective levers RAISE it. Xq27.1 (OMIM 300746). NCBI official symbol F9. X-linked recessive. Coding/nonsense lesions; the 'haemophilia B Leyden' F9-promoter variants are a separate regulatory class (noted, not modelled).
per_gene.src: Choo 1982 Nature 299:178 (F9 cloned); Kurachi 1982 PNAS 79:6461 (F9 cDNA); Bolton-Maggs and Pasi 2003 Lancet 361:1801 (the haemophilias)

emergence.firewall: gamma reads promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only; perturbation DIRECTION is forced+cited; MAGNITUDE is [O] (runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable).

levers.push_direction: restore endogenous factor IX expression by liver-directed AAV F9 (Padua hyperfunctional variant) gene transfer -> raise factor IX -> restore coagulation drive (axis UP toward haemostasis)
levers.agent_class: AAV F9 gene replacement (etranacogene dezaparvovec; also fidanacogene elaparvovec)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] restored factor-IX level / bleed-rate magnitude not derived from sequence
levers.src: Nathwani 2011 NEJM 365:2357 and 2014 NEJM 371:1994 (AAV F9 first-in-human); etranacogene dezaparvovec (Hemgenix) FDA 2022 / EMA 2023 -- first approved haemophilia B gene therapy; fidanacogene elaparvovec (Beqvez) FDA 2024

levers.push_direction: supply exogenous factor IX protein -> raise factor IX -> restore coagulation drive (the long-standing established replace arm)
levers.agent_class: factor IX protein replacement (recombinant / plasma-derived; extended-half-life Fc / albumin / PEG fusions)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] restored factor-IX activity / bleed-protection magnitude not derived from sequence

falsifiers.claim: F9 LOF lowers coagulation-cascade output (haemostasis under-driven)
falsifiers.falsifier: an F9 LOF allele that RAISED thrombin generation / shortened clotting time, or that improved haemostasis, would refute the drive-down direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: plasma factor IX activity and thrombin-generation / aPTT clotting assay stratified by F9 genotype

falsifiers.claim: restoring factor IX (replace) is the CORRECTIVE direction
falsifiers.falsifier: if raising factor IX REDUCED coagulation output or WORSENED bleeding, the 'replace factor' lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: thrombin generation / bleed-rate response to factor IX restoration (gene transfer or protein replacement)
